# metro

> metro is an open-source CLI for Metronome billing, for any Metronome tenant. It is read-only by default. Every write goes preview, typed confirm hash, apply, then a read-back that compares expected and actual. Canonical copy: https://metrocli.com/llms.txt

## Set up metro (do these in order)

1. Install: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/metrocli/metro.git ~/.metro/src && bash ~/.metro/src/scripts/install-global.sh` (once `@metrocli/metro` is published to npm, `npm install -g @metrocli/metro` also works)
2. Run: `metro init --agent` (creates ~/.metro/.env with mode 600, sets read-only mode, never prompts)
3. Ask the human to create a sandbox token at https://app.metronome.com/sandbox/developer/api-tokens and paste it into ~/.metro/.env after `METRONOME_SANDBOX_KEY=` in their editor. Never ask for a key in chat.
4. When they say "done": `metro init --check --json`. Continue only when `keys.sandbox.status` is `working`; otherwise relay `next`.
5. Read ~/.metro/AGENTS.md (the full operating manual) before any change.

## Safety rules

- Read-only by default. Writes need `metro mode write`, set by the human.
- Sandbox first. Always pass `--sandbox` or `--prod`; metro never picks production on its own.
- Ladder: preview (prints `payloadHash`) > show the human > apply with `--confirm-hash` > read back > report expected vs actual.
- Production only with the human's explicit typed yes in chat for that specific change.
- Never print or echo keys. Never cat ~/.metro/.env.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` usage/validation/API error, `2` safety refusal, `3` read-back mismatch after a live write (the write happened; read the log, do not re-run).

## Learn the tenant first

- `metro status --json`
- `metro catalog bind --sandbox --write`
- `metro tenant snapshot show --sandbox --markdown`
- `metro ops who "<customer>" --sandbox`

## Provisioning commands

`metro customer create`, `metro ratecard create`, `metro package create`, `metro contract create`, `metro subscription add`, `metro subscription set-quantity`, plus `metro contract move-plan|extend-trial|expire`, `metro ledger-adjustment`, `metro billing-provider cutover` (each: preflight, then apply).

## Metronome model

Usage events > billable metrics > products + rate cards > packages (contract templates) > contracts (commits, credits, subscriptions/seats) > invoices.

## Official Metronome API reference

metro's docs are the safety and workflow layer, not a copy of Metronome's API reference.

- Authoritative, current API details: https://docs.metronome.com/llms.txt (index). Append `.md` to any docs.metronome.com page URL for that page as markdown.
- What metro wraps: [API coverage](https://github.com/metrocli/metro/blob/main/docs/metronome-cli/API_COVERAGE.md) ([JSON](https://github.com/metrocli/metro/blob/main/docs/metronome-cli/API_COVERAGE.json)): every documented endpoint, its Metronome page, and metro's status (`op`, `catalog-read`, `catalog-write`, `not-yet`). Checked weekly against llms-full.txt.

Propose three concrete next actions the human can say yes to, based on what you learned about their tenant.
